note: Outside the stated ICP on the criteria that can be evidenced, and the rep effectively said so himself by disqualifying him from the core offer within eight minutes. Income is unambiguous and volunteered: 'I don't really have the money to pay for a gym membership month to month', with a hard ceiling of $200/month. Occupation was never asked — a gap in its own right — but the disclosed financial position is direct evidence against the successful/income pair the ICP is built on. His health is not a neglected side-issue either: he has a symptomatic undiagnosed shoulder problem under active investigation, which is closer to a clinical constraint than to the 'still good, wants good to great' profile. Starting point and conditioning were never established, so those two criteria are left unjudged rather than guessed. Worth noting for the rollup: this is the second prospect in this batch routed to a sub-$1,000 product because the stated ICP screens on money but the funnel does not.
